response.title: what is the best portable power station for cpap
response.answer:
For CPAP use, I recommend a LiFePO4 portable power station with at least 500Wh of battery capacity, preferably one that supports DC power output.

The best choice depends on whether you're using it for camping, air travel, or backup power during outages.

For most people, I would prioritize:

Battery capacity: 500–1,000Wh for multiple nights.

DC output: More efficient than running your CPAP through an AC inverter.

LiFePO4 battery: Long lifespan and good durability.

Pure sine wave AC outlet: Important if you're using your CPAP's normal wall adapter.

Low standby consumption: Some power stations waste considerable energy keeping their AC inverter running.

The biggest factor in battery life is whether you use your CPAP's heated humidifier and heated tubing. These can dramatically increase power consumption.
